verdict.rationale: Supermemory documents a public API with an API reference, official TypeScript and Python clients that wrap it, and endpoints for adding content, searching, memory operations, and list/get/update/delete on documents. An llms.txt index is also served, which helps AI-driven use. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (every probed path returned 404), independent hands-on corroboration of the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Official clients wrap this API: TypeScript: npm install supermemory Python: pip install supermemory
List, get, update, and delete your ingested documents
await client.add({ content: "The user loves Paris.", containerTag: "user_123" });
Create memories directly without going through the document ingestion workflow. Memories are embedded and immediately searchable.
